newsitem.title: UK: NatWest names new head of global FX prop trading.
newsitem.headline: NatWest names new head of global FX prop trading.

text.p: NatWest Markets said David Buchen had been appointed as a managing director responsible for global proprietary trading in foreign exchange and related products.
Buchen, who will be based in the U.S., joins NatWest from Citibank, where he had been managing director in the forex group since 1994, NatWest said in a statement.
Prior to that, Buchen worked at Citibank affiliate Saudi American Bank and at Bank America International.
"This is a key hire for NatWest Markets in terms of our ability to leverage further our research and knowledge base," said Howard Kurz, NatWest Markets' head of global foreign exchange.
NatWest Markets is the corporate and investment banking arm of NatWest Group.
